subject: Marketplace invoice: withholding exception & vendor-entity aliasing
messages:
From: Emma Chen <emma@cloudnet.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace invoice — withholding tax exception request

Hi Stephanie,

We received AWS Marketplace invoice #3421 (purchase date 2026-07-29) but our tax team flagged a withholding tax (WHT) requirement because the billing entity on the invoice is CloudNet Solutions US LLC while the payment will be made from our EU entity (CloudNet EMEA Ltd). We need either: 

- an invoice reissued to CloudNet EMEA Ltd with the EU VAT and tax-residency details, or
- a WHT exemption confirmation/attestation so our APAC/EU finance team can process payment without applying withholding at source.

Attached is our local WHT certificate for CloudNet EMEA Ltd (CloudNet_WHT_Certificate.pdf). Payment is due 2026-09-05 — can you advise whether Redwood can reissue or whether this needs to go through AWS? If AWS is the seller of record for this transaction, we understand reissue might not be possible and we'd need a marketplace flow.

Appreciate a quick read on options and next steps.

Thanks,
Emma Chen
Head of Finance
CloudNet Solutions
emma@cloudnet.com
+44 20 7123 4567

Attachment: CloudNet_WHT_Certificate.pdf

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Emma Chen <emma@cloudnet.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice — withholding tax exception request

Emma — thanks for the note and the certificate. Looping in Karthik (finance) and Vanessa (partner ops) to confirm the right path. Quick answers up-front:

- If AWS Marketplace was Seller of Record (SOR) for this line item, Redwood cannot directly reissue the AWS invoice — AWS issues tax invoices for SOR transactions.
- If Redwood was SOR (co-sell where Redwood is the billed seller), we can reissue an invoice and/or apply an entity alias for the billing entity.

Karthik / Vanessa — can you review the attached certificate and advise: 1) whether the evidence is sufficient for an EU VAT alias or WHT exemption; 2) if we need to kick an AWS case or if we can prepare a reissued invoice template (if Redwood was SOR). I'm adding a short internal checklist we usually use (redwood-marketplace-tax-steps.docx).

Emma — can you confirm the purchase path (AWS console purchase vs. consolidated billing via reseller)? Also, please share the exact CloudNet legal name and VAT/tax ID you need on the invoice for CloudNet EMEA Ltd. If AWS needs escalation, do you have an AWS partner rep contact (cc'ed John Alvarez if available)?

I'll keep this tight — payment date is close and we want to avoid hold-ups.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Marketplace & Channels
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-tax-steps.docx

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, Emma Chen <emma@cloudnet.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice — withholding tax exception request

Thanks for the context. Short checklist from Finance and the recommended routing: 

1) Confirm Seller of Record (SOR)
   - If SOR = AWS (AWS issues invoice): Redwood cannot reissue. External buyer must submit tax evidence to AWS or request AWS to reissue (we can provide a template).
   - If SOR = Redwood: we can reissue to the requested legal entity and add VAT/tax IDs.

2) Evidence required (EU withholding / reverse-charge / aliasing)
   - Signed WHT certificate or tax residency (you provided — good start).
   - VAT registration number for CloudNet EMEA Ltd (for reverse charge).
   - Confirmation of billing payer entity and country of tax residency.

3) If SOR = AWS, recommended actions:
   - Emma: open an AWS Marketplace support case attaching the WHT cert and request invoice reissue. Copy our partner rep (John Alvarez) and Redwood partner ops.
   - Redwood can request AWS to add an "invoice alias" but AWS requires buyer-side documentation and an AWS case ID.

4) If SOR = Redwood, we'll follow our internal reissue flow: collect legal name + VAT/tax ID + PO if needed + signed WHT cert. We will then reissue and send credit note for the original. Typical turnaround 3 business days after docs received.

Reference docs: marketplace-seller-of-record-matrix.pdf (shows SOR rules by marketplace), HubSpot deal DN-2026-1598 (linked).

Next steps for this thread: Emma — please confirm SOR and supply the exact legal name/VAT. If SOR=AWS, we will provide the invoice template and coordinate with John (AWS). If SOR=Redwood, we'll initiate reissue and quote ETA.

-Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Ops & Finance, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: marketplace-seller-of-record-matrix.pdf

From: Emma Chen <emma@cloudnet.com>

Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice — withholding tax exception request

Thanks, all — confirmed with our procurement team: this was purchased via AWS Marketplace where AWS acted as Seller of Record (SOR). We've opened an AWS support case (CASE-98765) and copied John (AWS) to expedite. We've attached the original invoice (invoice_3421.pdf).

Immediate asks for Redwood:
- Can you provide a one-page invoice-reissue template and a short note we can include in the AWS case asking AWS to accept the CloudNet EMEA Ltd tax evidence?
- If AWS is unable to reissue, would Redwood accept a credit memo and new invoice in the event we move billing to Redwood SOR for future purchases? We'd need that path documented for procurement.

We appreciate the quick responses — payment team will wait on AWS case outcome but asked for explicit guidance we can include in the case to avoid automatic withholding.

Best,
Emma Chen
Head of Finance
CloudNet Solutions

Attachment: invoice_3421.pdf
